gramlot-js-server 0.2.3 lets the single file of `@gramlot/gramlot-serverless` run inline code. `@gramlot/gramlot-js-server` has no code changes; its version follows the repository.

## Changes

- `@gramlot/gramlot-serverless`: the Content Security Policy of the single file adds `'unsafe-eval'` to `script-src`, so the page compiles the inline code (`formula`, `script`, `==`, `action`, `connect_on<event>`, `_if`/`_else`) of the Source it receives from its Worker. The runtime script stays allowed by its hash, without `'unsafe-inline'`. `connect-src` is `*`: connections stay open until a page can declare its own policy.
- `@gramlot/gramlot-serverless` requires the core `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.3 or later: from 0.2.3 the core runs only the inline code received with the Source, refuses inline code read from Data, and refuses `on<event>` attributes and `javascript:` URLs. `@gramlot/gramlot-js-server` still requires 0.2.1 or later.
- New example `serverless/examples/inline-code` and its Chromium check `serverless/scripts/verify_inline_browser.mjs`.

```sh
npm install @gramlot/gramlot @gramlot/gramlot-js-server
npm install @gramlot/gramlot @gramlot/gramlot-serverless
```

## Verified

Node.js 23.11, Chromium 153, with the core 0.2.3: server and serverless tests, and the Chromium checks of the exported files (hello world, Source live, inline code, sentinel, quick start).
